Name: Mystic Truffle Foxes for CP
Author: DPitSimp
Description:
This mod is one that's been cooking for a long time. A bit of a silly premise that turned into a kind of overpowered animal. The Mystic Foxes can be purchased for 22,000 gold. They are grown when purchased so they should start digging truffles day one or two, sometimes they take the first day off.

There are 9 skins total, one of which is rarer than the rest, but this has no functional effect. Any fox can dig up any truffle variant. Each of 8 truffles offers various combinations of buffs:

[b]Red Velvet Truffle [/b][i]63 Edibility[/i]
+2 Luck
+2 Speed
+4 Defense

[b]Blueberry Truffle[/b][i] 63 Edibility
[/i]+2 Mining
+2 Speed
+4 Attack

[b]Cake Truffle[/b][i] 45 Edibility
[/i]+1 Mining
+1 Luck
+1 Speed
+2 Defense
+2 Attack

[b]Dark Lemon Truffle [/b][i]60 Edibility
[/i]+35 Max Stamina
+3 Speed

[b]Dark Orange Truffle [/b][i]60 Edibility
[/i]+35 Max Stamina
+3 Fishing

[b]Dark Raspberry Truffle[/b][i] 60 Edibility
[/i]+35 Max Stamina
+3 Attack

[b]Irish Cream Truffle[/b][i] 63 Edibility
[/i]+15 Max Stamina
+2 Mining
+2 Defense
+1 Attack

[b]Salted Caramel Truffle [/b][i]63 Edibility
[/i]+15 Max Stamina
+2 Mining
+2 Attack
+1 Defense

All truffles sell for 2000 gold base, do not increase in quality, and are affected by the artisan profession


[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12755?tab=description]Pig to Fox Sound[/url] Graciously let me integrate the sound into my mod!
Thank you [url=http://next.nexusmods.com/profile/silvermoonchan/about-me]silvermoonchan[/url] for showing me how to do the integration!
